# Björn Borg Q2'26: Svagare försäljning, starkare marginal

**Feed**: inderes-se  
**Published**: 2026-08-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Inderes TV episode is a CEO interview with Björn Borg's Henrik Bunge covering the Q2'26 report: sales fell 12% in the quarter (down 1.4% H1) due to timing effects and a weaker wholesale order book, while gross margin improved 5.6% and operating margin rose on channel mix (e-commerce +17% at 77-78% margins), FX tailwinds, lower discounts and 9% lower opex. Management frames profitability as solved and growth—especially wholesale and the still-loss-leading but profitable footwear category—as the key remaining challenge, and reaffirms a capital-allocation focus on the own brand and dividends over M&A.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 BORG — Björn Borg | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Profitability strong (GM +5.6%, op margin +11%, opex -9%, e-comm +17% at 77-78% margins) but top-line contracted 12% in Q2; growth is the unresolved challenge.

#### Reasoning

Björn Borg has clearly solved profitability—wide margins, tight cost control, strong high-margin e-commerce and FX/discount tailwinds—but broke a 25-quarter growth streak with a 12% Q2 sales drop driven by timing effects and a thinner wholesale order book. Management refuses guidance and admits footwear and wholesale distribution remain weak. Attractive margin profile offsets soft growth, supporting a hold pending evidence that wholesale reorders and footwear can turn.

#### Sell Triggers

- if wholesale order book keeps shrinking into 2027 preorders
- if footwear declines fail to stabilise
- if e-commerce growth decelerates below wholesale drag
- if gross margin gains reverse on weaker FX/higher discounts

> *"Vår utmaning nu... var lönsamheten. Det är det inte. Vi har otroligt fina marginaler... Vår utmaning är att vi måste skapa tillväxt och framför allt hållsäljare."*
